subject: Re: Contract amendment — phased expansion credit schedule & invoice alignment
messages:
From: Marc Yin <marc.yin@orion-dynamics.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orion-dynamics.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal + expansion discussion — pricing ask

Hi Rishi,

We’re getting close to the end of year planning at Orion and need to lock the renewal that starts 2027-01-01. Usage has grown faster than forecast — Q4 looks +45% vs plan — so we want to add an additional reserved capacity tranche (~30% uplift) for Jan–Jun, and then a permanent uplift for the second half.

Key asks from procurement:
- Maintain current unit price for the first 6 months of the renewal (price hold through 2027-06-30) while we transition workloads.
- A one-time onboarding credit to offset migration engineering (we've previously seen similar credits).
- Clarify how true-ups/invoices will align with our billing cycle (monthly vs quarterly).

We want a commercial path that avoids short-term sticker shock for our product teams but preserves your contracted economics. Can you share a proposal (credits, temporary price hold, and invoice cadence) by next Wednesday? We’d like to present to the procurement committee on 12/17.

Thanks —
Marc
VP, Cloud Platform, Orion Dynamics

--
Orion Dynamics | marc.yin@orion-dynamics.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marc Yin <marc.yin@orion-dynamics.com>
Cc: procurement@orion-dynamics.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion discussion — pricing ask

Marc —

Thanks for the clear ask and the usage file you shared earlier. I put together a preliminary commercial approach that I think meets Orion’s goals and preserves predictability for both sides. High level:

1) Temporary price hold: keep current unit price through 2027-06-30 for existing commit + the additional 30% reserved tranche applied to Jan–Jun.
2) Onboarding credit: one-time credit equal to 15% of the estimated incremental invoice for Jan–Mar to offset migration work (applied as credit on first invoice after go-live).
3) Commit reshuffle & staged uplift: convert the 30% temporary tranche into a stepped permanent uplift starting 2027-07-01 (50% of the uplift becomes permanent in H2 2027, remainder rolled-in on 2028-01-01 unless we agree earlier).
4) Billing cadence: invoices remain monthly; true-ups calculated monthly but each quarter we’ll provide a reconciliation report and a single consolidated adjustment invoice (to simplify Oracle/payables).

I’ve attached a short proposal (Orion_MA_Pricing_Proposal_v3.pdf) and pulled your Q4 usage (orion-usage-Q4-2026.csv) into the model. This is a draft we can tighten after internal approvals.

If this direction looks reasonable I’ll loop in Ben and Priyom to confirm margin/finance tolerance and finalize language for the amendment/DocuSign.

Next steps proposed:
- Internal review by our finance/ops team by 12/13
- Final proposal to Orion by 12/16 to hit your 12/17 procurement committee

Would you be available for a 30-min sync on Monday 12/14 to walk the numbers?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 07:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + expansion discussion — pricing ask

Ben, Priyom — forwarding Orion’s ask and the draft I sent them (attached). Headline ask: temporary price hold through 2027-06-30 for current + 30% temporary tranche, plus a one-time onboarding credit (15% of incremental Jan–Mar).

Finance/ops questions:
- Ben: can we accept a 6-month price hold for the incremental tranche and still hit target blended ASP for the year? Any constraints on the credit being recognized up front vs amortized?
- Priyom: if we stagger the permanent uplift (50% H2 2027, remainder 2028-01-01), how does that affect forecasting for our Dedicated capacity planning and GPU reservations?

I’ll be on the call with Marc on 12/14 at 10:00 PT — looking for a quick thumbs-up so I can present the approach.

Thanks —
Rishi

Rishi — quick read:
- 6-month price hold on incremental tranche is doable if onboarding credit is limited to Jan–Mar and amortized over 3 months for revenue recognition. Otherwise the P&L hit is front-loaded and needs a C-level sign-off.
- I recommend conditioning the 15% credit on quick deployment milestones (two-week checkpoints) so we can claw back if rollout stalls.
- Margin impact: blended ASP drops ~6% in H1 2027 on the model you sent; acceptable but leaves less headroom for concessions elsewhere.

If you want, I can draft the finance clause about credit amortization and milestone triggers.

Ben
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

Marc —

Thanks for the call earlier this week. Per our alignment, attached is the updated pricing amendment (Orion_MA_Pricing_Proposal_v3.pdf) and a short mutual action plan:

Mutual action plan (summary)
- 2027-01-01: Renewal goes live with existing commit + temporary 30% reserved tranche active.
- 2027-01-01 — 2027-03-31: Onboarding period; Orion receives a one-time credit equal to 15% of estimated incremental Jan–Mar invoices, applied as a credit on the April invoice. Credit is amortized over Apr–Jun for revenue recognition but visible in April statement.
- 2027-04-01 — 2027-06-30: Price hold continues for both original commit and the temporary tranche. Monthly true-ups continue; quarterly reconciliation invoice consolidated.
- 2027-07-01: Stepped permanent uplift — 50% of the temporary tranche becomes part of committed baseline. Remaining uplift to be added 2028-01-01 unless both parties agree to accelerate.
- DocuSign: I’ve attached the redline-ready amendment and created a DocuSign envelope (link below).

Operational notes:
- Credit triggers: two deployment checkpoints (by 2027-02-15 and 2027-03-15). If checkpoints are missed, credit reduces pro-rata.
- Capacity planning: Priyom will coordinate with your cloudops team to ensure Dedicated pools are reserved for H1.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm procurement OKs the milestone-conditioned credit and monthly invoice cadence by 12/21.
2) Once confirmed we’ll finalize the DocuSign and schedule an ops handoff.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleProposal
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/secure/link/EXAMPLE-ORION-DEAL-4821

Appreciate the work to get this across the line — let me know if you need a one-pager for your procurement committee.
